instruction: I want to emphasize slide 3 in LibreOffice Impress. Please duplicate slide 3 ("Discuss:") and insert the duplicate immediately after the original (as the new slide 4).

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: This task requires duplicating a slide. The evaluator checks if: (1) total slides increased to 13, and (2) both slide 3 and 4 have the same title "Discuss:". Verified by checking original slide 3 title.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts slide count and titles at the right indices (slides 3 and 4, using 0-based indexing 2 and 3)
Metric correctly verifies both requirements: total slide count increased to 13 (0.5 credit) and both slides have matching title 'Discuss:' (0.5 credit)
Partial credit logic is sensible and covers the two main verification aspects
Postconfig appropriately saves the file (Ctrl+S) to ensure changes are persisted before verification
Title extraction logic is robust with fallback mechanisms (checks placeholder format first, then any text shape)
Expected values are semantically correct: count=13 implies original had 12 slides, title='Discuss:' matches instruction requirement
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Expected count (13) assumes original file has 12 slides, but this is not verifiable from task JSON alone. Acceptable if verified during task generation.
Minor: Does not explicitly verify that the duplicate is inserted immediately after the original, but checking consecutive indices 2 and 3 with same title and count+1 is a reasonable proxy.
